scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Analytic proof based on the Gaussian transform, the homogeneous-distribution Fourier formula, and a uniform Taylor remainder. No numerical experiment is treated as proof.
limitations: No uniformity in dimension is claimed.
Only the first positive radial zero is located; simplicity and later zeros are not addressed.
The 2010 characteristic-function article was assessed from its abstract and bibliographic record only; this remains a literature-overlap risk.

title: A logarithmic boundary law for the first Fourier zero of generalized Gaussians \(e^{-\|x\|_2^{2+\varepsilon}}\)
